help.install.title: Install and updates
help.install.ios.title: Add to Home Screen on iPhone
help.install.ios.step2: Tap the Share button, then Add to Home Screen.
help.install.ios.step3: Open it from the Home Screen icon to play full screen.
help.install.update.title: The game says an update is ready
help.install.update.step1: Finish what you are doing, then choose Restart in the update notice.
help.install.update.step2: If nothing happens, close every tab of the game and open it again.
help.performance.title: Performance
help.performance.slow.title: The game runs slowly
help.performance.slow.step1: Open Settings, then Graphics, and choose a lower quality.
help.performance.slow.step3: On a phone, keep it plugged in and out of the sun.
help.performance.load.title: The game will not finish loading
help.performance.load.step1: Check your connection and reload the page.
help.performance.load.step2: Open Settings, then Install and storage, and check free space.
help.performance.load.step3: If it still stops, copy the diagnostics from the error page and send them with your report.
help.graphics.title: Graphics and crashes
help.graphics.gpu.title: Graphics could not start
help.graphics.gpu.step1: Turn on hardware acceleration in your browser settings.
help.graphics.gpu.step2: Update your browser and your graphics driver.
help.graphics.gpu.step3: Try compatibility mode in Settings, then Graphics.
help.graphics.crash.title: The game stopped
help.graphics.crash.step1: Reload the page: you return to your last save.
help.graphics.crash.step2: Lower the quality in Settings if it happens often.
help.graphics.crash.step3: Copy the diagnostics from the Pause menu when you report it.
help.audio.title: Audio
help.audio.silent.title: There is no sound
help.audio.silent.step1: Tap or press a key once: the browser waits for a first touch before it plays audio.
help.audio.silent.step2: Check the volume sliders in Settings, then Audio.
help.audio.silent.step3: Check that the device is not on silent.
help.controls.title: Controls and gamepads
help.controls.pad.title: My gamepad is not found
help.controls.pad.step1: Press any button on the gamepad while the game is open.
help.controls.pad.step2: Connect it before you open the page, or reconnect it.
help.controls.remap.title: Change a control
help.controls.remap.step2: Choose the device, select the control and press the new key or button.
help.saves.title: Saves and storage
help.saves.storage.title: Progress cannot be saved
help.saves.storage.step1: Leave private browsing: it does not keep saves.
help.saves.storage.step2: Free space on the device, then reload.
help.saves.storage.step3: Export your profile from Saves to keep a copy.
help.saves.lost.title: My save is missing
help.saves.lost.step1: Open Saves and look at every profile.
help.saves.lost.step2: Import an export file if you have one.
help.vr.title: VR
help.vr.enter.title: Enter VR is missing
help.vr.enter.step2: The button shows only when the browser reports that VR is ready.
help.online.title: Online and account

help.online.region.step1: The game is not offered in some regions yet.
help.online.region.step2: Your local saves are not affected.
help.online.signin.title: I cannot sign in
help.online.signin.step2: Playing without an account is always possible.
xr.test.title: Test panel
tycoon.events.biz.competitor_launch.body: Helix Works just launched a product that overlaps yours. Signups are getting pricier.
tycoon.events.biz.price_war.title: Price war
tycoon.events.biz.price_war.body: Your rivals are slashing prices and customers are asking why you have not.
tycoon.events.biz.engineer_poached.title: A recruiter called your engineer
tycoon.events.biz.engineer_poached.body: A bigger firm is offering your best engineer a lot of money.
tycoon.events.biz.outage.title: Everything is down
tycoon.events.biz.outage.body: The service fell over during a busy hour. Customers are posting screenshots.
tycoon.events.biz.viral_launch.title: You went viral
tycoon.events.biz.viral_launch.body: A post about your product took off overnight. Signups are climbing fast.
tycoon.events.biz.scaling_strain.title: Growing pains
tycoon.events.biz.scaling_strain.body: The sudden growth is straining the old code. Quick fixes are piling up.
tycoon.events.biz.acquisition_offer.body: Northgate Holdings has sent an offer to acquire the company at a fair price.
tycoon.events.biz.cloud_bill_spike.title: Utilities bill spike
tycoon.events.biz.cloud_bill_spike.body: This month the hosting bill came in far higher than planned.
tycoon.events.biz.enterprise_whale.title: A big customer signs
tycoon.events.biz.enterprise_whale.body: A large company has signed up for the top plan and brought colleagues with it.
tycoon.events.biz.founder_burnout.title: The founder is fried
tycoon.events.biz.founder_burnout.body: Months of late nights have caught up. Nobody has seen you smile in days.
tycoon.events.biz.security_incident.body: A researcher found a hole in your login flow. Some customer data may have been exposed.
tycoon.events.biz.talent_wave.title: Layoffs elsewhere
tycoon.events.biz.talent_wave.body: Other companies are shedding staff and good people are looking for work.
tycoon.events.pol.payroll_tax.title: New payroll tax
tycoon.events.pol.payroll_tax.body: The city passed a payroll levy that hits growing teams.
tycoon.events.pol.ai_ordinance.title: AI ordinance
tycoon.events.pol.ai_ordinance.body: The city council passed rules on automated tools. Buyers are cautious.
tycoon.events.pol.hardware_tariff.title: Hardware tariff
tycoon.events.pol.hardware_tariff.body: A new tariff raises the cost of imported parts.
tycoon.events.pol.permit_freeze.title: Permit freeze
tycoon.events.pol.permit_freeze.body: The city paused new operating permits for fleet services.
tycoon.events.pol.city_grant.title: City innovation grant
tycoon.events.pol.city_grant.body: The city is handing out small grants to local startups.
tycoon.events.nat.quake_major.title: The big one
tycoon.events.nat.quake_major.body: A major earthquake rattled the Bay Area. The office is closed for inspection.
tycoon.events.nat.quake_minor.title: Rumble
tycoon.events.nat.quake_minor.body: A small quake shook the office. Coffee everywhere, work stopped for a while.
tycoon.events.nat.atmospheric_river.body: Storms flooded the streets and the team worked from home.
tycoon.events.nat.wildfire_smoke.title: Smoke days
tycoon.events.nat.wildfire_smoke.body: Wildfire smoke turned the sky orange. Everyone has a headache.
tycoon.events.nat.fog_week.title: Fog week
tycoon.events.nat.fog_week.body: The fog never lifted. Productivity dipped, vibes are moody.
tycoon.events.nat.blackout.title: Blackout
tycoon.events.nat.blackout.body: Power is out across several neighborhoods, including yours.
tycoon.events.cul.ai_hype_peak.title: The hype peak
tycoon.events.cul.ai_hype_peak.body: Everyone is talking about automated tools and investors want in.
tycoon.events.cul.ai_hype_crash.title: The hype crash
tycoon.events.cul.ai_hype_crash.body: The excitement ended as fast as it began. Funding talks went cold.
tycoon.events.cul.speculation_winter.bod: A cold stretch for risky bets. Investors are cautious across the board.
tycoon.events.cul.endorsement.title: A celebrity cameo
tycoon.events.cul.endorsement.body: A well-known local personality offers to back your product for a fee.
tycoon.events.cul.parade_week.title: Championship parade
tycoon.events.cul.parade_week.body: The whole city is at the parade and the office is empty. Foot traffic is up though.
tycoon.events.cul.meme_moment.title: Meme moment
tycoon.events.cul.meme_moment.body: Your product became a joke online. The attention is not all kind.
tycoon.events.cul.backlash_wave.title: Backlash
tycoon.events.cul.backlash_wave.body: People are piling on your company online.
tycoon.events.mkt.rate_cut.title: Rates cut
tycoon.events.mkt.rate_cut.body: Borrowing got cheaper and investors are in a better mood.
tycoon.events.mkt.rate_hike.title: Rates up
tycoon.events.mkt.rate_hike.body: Borrowing got pricier and valuations are slipping.
tycoon.events.mkt.ipo_window.title: The IPO window opens
tycoon.events.mkt.ipo_window.body: Public markets are welcoming new listings for a while.
tycoon.events.mkt.down_round_wave.title: Down-round wave
tycoon.events.mkt.down_round_wave.body: Funds are repricing their deals. Expect tougher terms.
tycoon.events.mkt.crash.title: Market crash
tycoon.events.mkt.crash.body: Stocks tumbled and funding dried up overnight.
tycoon.events.vc.retrade.title: The investor wants to re-trade
tycoon.events.vc.retrade.body: Mid-closing, your lead investor asks to lower the price.
tycoon.events.fin.bridge_offer.title: Bridge note offered
tycoon.events.fin.bridge_offer.body: The bank is empty. A friendly fund offers a bridge note on rough terms.

dialogue.safety.body: This message is from {brand}, not from the character. If you are thinking about hurting yourself, you are not alone, and talking to someone can help.
dialogue.safety.us: In the United States, you can call or text 988 at any hour to reach the Suicide and Crisis Lifeline.
dialogue.safety.resources.body: The 988 Suicide and Crisis Lifeline is free and open day and night in the United States: call or text 988. If you are in danger right now, call your local emergency number.
